title: ACI 318, Section 10.
officialText:
12. Modify ACI 318 by adding Section 10.12.4 to read as follows:
10.12.4 When the specified compressive strength of concrete in a column is greater than 1.4 times that specified for a floor
system, the following additional requirements shall be adhered to:
1. All of the design provisions of Section 10.12 (unmodified) are adhered to.
2. The concrete construction is supervised and inspected continuously by a full-time professional engineer responsible
for the concrete placement special inspection. Such professional engineer shall not delegate this responsibility to any
subordinates.
SECTION BC 1909
STRUCTURAL PLAIN CONCRETE
